notes.title: Major Update: Version 1.1.0 – Comprehensive Visual Upgrade
notes.content:
[olist][*][p]Upgraded most scene effects for stronger visual impact.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/5bdb13c8a67d99a1d94066a2d3f65c60fd7058e1.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Added dynamic weather system to deepen atmosphere.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/18a580e032a3cfa8b067744824c30568f3e0fe1e.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Complete UI art overhaul.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/ee6f412c1af95052bba6b96a463747b960c24d5c.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Black Butterfly Blade available earlier, enriching new-player experience (no effect on old saves).[/p][/*][*][p]Extensive refinements to protagonist’s feel and responsiveness.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various monster-related bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced behaviors of select monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added story-relevant collectibles in chests to enrich narrative (no impact on achievements; already-opened chests in old saves won’t contain them).[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: 4.18Demo Update
notes.content:
1.Add 3 Weapons into demo, which can be purchased in the statue store.
2. Add butterfly fire in charged attack, for better combat experience.
3. Adjust drop souls values.

notes.title: 4.3Demo Update
notes.content:
1. Texture Optimization, for better performance.
2. Character adjusted, lower difficulty.

notes.title: Major update (29 March)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/b12b64a814937e914e86d3246e4a20ead7b23efd.jpg[/img]

[h3]We have made the following adjustments in the latest update to the Butterfly Dream’s demo[/h3]
[h3]1. Optimise scene frame rate[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/9deedb304905de619ec861f6a024944b085d2e5e.jpg[/img]
[h3]2. Adjust the monster battle rhythm, modify the solo enemy judgement.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/e3842686d99d24abf814ab7b7945341e5551a24f.jpg[/img]
[h3]3. Added guide content, and opening CG.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/3425d8a7896c04b6fbb345d89dd127cba34f0e16.jpg[/img]
[h3]4. enriched all scene details and showed subsequent levels.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/49cd344b25ef1fa49fe23f842f35a3d966c01cd2.jpg[/img]
[h3]5. Supplement the plot, new plot props ‘tarsus’.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/a940c2aa720d464b571968da40844b11233924ac.jpg[/img]
[h3]6. original monster model details added.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45120897/03a4ae309f42e9e42341597e6ddc48af8771b7fc.jpg[/img]
[h3]7. Main character skills revamped, number of skills increased.[/h3]
[h3]8. Increase consumable items.
[h3]9.New memories function, players get unique buff bonus after defeating BOSS.[/h3]

[h3]PS: English voice temporarily off.[/h3]

notes.title: Demo Update, bug fix
notes.content:
1、Fix the invisible wall bug reported by a player.
2、Reduced difficulty for enemies, better combat. 
3、Key settings added for both keyboard and Gamepad.

notes.title: Demo Update & Playtest Now Available!
notes.content:
We have optimize the demo and fixed several bugs.
The video and audio settings are now available.

Playtest is open for registration.
We may not update the demo in future. Join the Playtest and it will be updated before the game releasing, we will listen to your voices to make Butterfly Dream better!
